display.purpose: Page titles and the Aether wordmark only. Rarely used.

headline.purpose: Section headers, panel titles, key metrics.

title.purpose: Card headers, navigation items, subsection labels.

body.purpose: Chat responses, RAG content, descriptive prose. Max 65ch line length.

label.purpose: UI chrome labels, button text, status badges, column headers. Always uppercase.

mono.purpose: ICAO codes, callsigns, coordinates, altitude, velocity, timestamps. All aviation data values.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Interactive card hover only. Never at rest.

shadows.name: modal-float
shadows.purpose: Modals and drawers floating above all other content.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for all transitions. Smooth, no bounce.

motion.name: micro
motion.purpose: Hover color changes, icon swaps, badge state.

motion.name: standard
motion.purpose: Button hover lift, border color shifts, focus ring.

motion.name: panel
motion.purpose: Panel slides, tab transitions, drawer open/close.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action. Sky blue, sharp edges, uppercase label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #38BDF8; color: #0B1120; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #62CCFA; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #38BDF8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #1A2540; color: #4A5E78; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent with sky-blue border and text.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #38BDF8; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid #1E2D47; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1), color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #38BDF8; color: #62CCFA; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #38BDF8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chat Input
components.description: Primary chat entry field. Full width, focused sky-blue border.
components.css: .ds-input-wrapper { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #141D2F; color: #E2E8F0; padding: 12px 44px 12px 14px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid #1E2D47; border-radius: 4px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #4A5E78; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #38BDF8; } .ds-input-send { position: absolute; right: 12px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; opacity: 0.7; transition: opacity 150ms; } .ds-input-send:hover { opacity: 1; }

components.name: User Message
components.description: User message in chat. Elevated surface, full width, labeled YOU.
components.html:
YOU

How many flights are currently over France?

components.description: Aether response. Distinguished by sky-blue left border, not bubble styling.
components.html:
AETHER

Currently tracking 847 flights over France. The highest altitude is 12,497m — Air France AF1234 at 834 km/h.
components.css: .ds-msg-assistant { background: #0B1120; border-left: 2px solid #38BDF8; padding: 16px 16px 16px 18px; } .ds-msg-label-aether { display: block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #38BDF8; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-msg-body { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.65; color: #E2E8F0; margin: 0; } .ds-code { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #E2E8F0; background: #1A2540; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Tool Call Indicator
components.description: Shown between messages when the agent is calling a tool. Pure text, no spinner.
components.css: .ds-tool-call { padding: 4px 16px 4px 20px; } .ds-tool-text { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #8899AA; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }

components.name: Navigation Tabs
components.description: Three primary tabs: Chat, Map, Analytics. Underline-only active state.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #1E2D47; } .ds-tab { background: none; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px; padding: 12px 20px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8899AA; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1); } .ds-tab:hover { color: #E2E8F0; } .ds-tab-active { color: #E2E8F0; border-bottom-color: #38BDF8; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #38BDF8; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.description: Inline status indicators. Text color carries the signal, not fill.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; background: #1A2540; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #38BDF8; } .ds-badge-anomaly { color: #F59E0B; }

narrative.overview:
Aether's interface takes its language from precision instruments — altimeters, radar screens, navigation displays — not as skeuomorphic recreation but as a philosophy: every element exists to convey information, nothing exists to look impressive. The surface is deep space, the data glows against it, and the operator reads it in a single focused pass.

The palette is committed. Deep navy owns 70%+ of every screen. Sky blue appears only where it earns it: interactive elements, live data, the cursor of attention. Horizon amber is reserved for anomalies — its rarity is its meaning.

Motion is aircraft-inspired: smooth, directional, deliberate. Nothing bounces. The base state is always still.
keyCharacteristics: Two-font system: Space Grotesk for UI, JetBrains Mono for data
Two accents only: sky blue for interaction, horizon amber for anomaly
Dense by default — whitespace is for rhythm, not emptiness

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Sky blue and horizon amber are the only colors that break from the neutral scale. No purple, no green, no teal, no gradient fills. Adding a third accent is prohibited.

rules.name: The Amber Reservation Rule
rules.body: Horizon amber appears only in response to anomalies or critical warnings. Using it decoratively destroys the signal.

rules.name: The Mono Data Rule
rules.body: Every aviation data value — callsign, ICAO code, latitude/longitude, altitude, velocity, timestamp — is rendered in JetBrains Mono. The type itself signals measurement, not description.

rules.name: The No-Sentence-Case Label Rule
rules.body: Labels and badges are uppercase Space Grotesk. Never title case, never sentence case for UI chrome.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: No element casts a shadow at rest. Shadows appear only on hover (interactive cards) or for modals. Nothing else.

rules.name: The Tonal Ladder Rule
rules.body: Depth increases one step at a time: Deep Space → Cockpit Surface → Instrument Panel. Skipping steps is only permitted for modals.

dos: Do render all aviation data values in JetBrains Mono
Do keep button and badge text uppercase with 0.1em tracking
Do use only Contrail borders (1px #1E2D47) for structural separation
Do treat Horizon Amber as a reserved signal for anomalies only
Do step through the tonal ladder one level at a time
Do use prefers-reduced-motion to replace translational animations with fades
Do test legibility for deuteranopia — use labels alongside color signals
Do load Space Grotesk and JetBrains Mono via Google Fonts custom CSS
donts: Don't use white (#ffffff) or pure black (#000000) anywhere
Don't add a third accent color
Don't build a generic AI product look — white background, rounded cards, gradient heroes
Don't recreate the ChatGPT/Claude UI — no alternating message bubbles
Don't use neon cyberpunk aesthetics — no glowing borders, no animated grids
Don't use the Notion/Linear off-white cream look
Don't use corner radius larger than 8px
Don't use border-left colored stripes decoratively
Don't use the hero-metric template for any data display
